finding: The contract of next-id --plan-seed puts the seed command on standard output and names no stream for the warnings of BR-100 or for the message that the counter is in use. VIRGIL reads the command from the output, and the Output row says one line. A warning on standard output breaks that line. Name the stream of each: for example, the warnings on standard error, and the in-use message on standard output.
why_this_severity: An implementer can follow the Failure row and send messages to standard error (no to fails_purpose); the CIF-06 tests must still guess where to read the warning (raises_cost).
